6\. A failed archive leaves a false review fetch 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
archive creates the numbered directory before writing its comment files, while run returns an
error without removing files already written. If a later write fails, the next invocation counts
that incomplete directory as a previous fetch and diffs against it.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A write failure can leave an incomplete numbered hosted-review archive that a later run treats as a completed fetch. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/hosted.py[146-165] - src/hands/hosted.py[315-331] ## Recommended Fix Write the complete fetch into a temporary directory, remove it on failure, and move it to the numbered archive path only after every write succeeds. Test a failure after one comment has been written. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
